description: Folder of the Mask2Former segmenter (files <name>_loss_best_loss.pth and <name>_parameters.pkl). Replaceable by another folder in the same format.

U-Net EfficientNet-B0, 4 channels (RGB + local contrast z), 384 thumbnail of fraction 0.30, sigmoid heat-map output. Trained on 19 September 2026 (eye_unet_unified_384_rgbz_hn_f030_sansrenfort). The associated thresholds are in eye_thresholds.csv and in the checkpoint (peak_thr_eval, peak_thr_cascade).

U-Net EfficientNet-B0, 4 channels, 384 thumbnail of fraction 0.45 on the dilated mask, blastema probability output. Split stratified by state and grouped by worm, validation Dice 0.866 (blasteme_unet_384_stratifie, 28 September 2026). TO BE REPLACED by the future model: same checkpoint format (key state_dict) or adapt blastema/blastema_detection.py.

ConvNeXt V2 base 384 + spatial transformer + metric head (97 descriptors), regression of the decimal state 1 to 6. Trained on all images (3 October 2026). The checkpoint carries metric_cols, metric_mean, metric_std, metric_median, ch_map. TO BE REPLACED by the future model: see stage/stage_prediction.py.
First eye detector (3 channels), used ONLY by the metrics chain (eye_inference_and_features, columns eye_*).
RGB+z detector with hard negatives, historical reference of the metrics chain (replaced by eye_detector in enrich_metrics_yeux_unet_v3 and enrich_metrics_pupille).

Blastema segmenter of the metrics chain (enrich_metrics_blasteme_seg, columns blast_seg_*). WARNING: this checkpoint was retrained on 15 September 2026 with the State_6 annotations (Dice 0.849) and is not the one (Dice 0.857) that produced the columns of the metric tables.
